reason: Hypothesis A is more specific and testable: it explicitly targets single-phase fcc FeCoNi (not a derivative like FeCoNiMnCu), proposes a clear intervention (50 at.% Pt to induce L1₀ ordering), and sets a precise falsification threshold (coercivity below ~200 Oe). Hypothesis B is largely a restatement of the cited FeCoNiMnCuPt result and lacks the same level of specificity for the FeCoNi system.
